Careers

We’re a group of humble and hard-working people with a passion for change (and a strong Giphy game). Growing and scaling companies is hard work. Our company succeeds because our employees have the spirit to thrive in a fast-paced environment. We strive to do better every day because we share a growth-oriented mindset.

See Our Open Positions

Benefits and Perks

In addition to competitive compensation, company equity, and health/vision/dental benefits, TrueAccord also goes above and beyond in providing our team a strong foundation to invest in the whole self, both at and beyond work.

Learn More About Our Offerings

Investing in our Employees

Career Development

TrueAccord strives to be a truly inclusive workplace, where diversity is more than just a concept. We recognize that a diverse workforce generates more innovative ideas, products, and services – and are proud that our family of companies has an equal gender split as well as women and minorities serving in key leadership positions. We offer leadership development training, as well as opportunities within the company for growth.

Flexibility

Depending on the position, we offer remote flexibility.

COVID-19 Response

We’re living in unprecedented times. At TrueAccord, we put our employees first. That’s why we offer remote flexibility for our employees across the nation. Our team is willing to work with the individual circumstances brought on by the pandemic.
